'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Jason Jenkins DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jason Jenkins]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Hunt Down and Destroy Jason and the Jedi.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jason Jenkins]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
